captions.text: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet standing. Notice how your back meets the floor.
Slowly let both knees go a little to the right, and come back to the middle.
Rest. Let the legs stand without holding them.
Now let the knees go to the left and come back. Is it the same as to the right?
Let the knees go to the right and leave them there.
Now roll your head to the left, and back to the middle.
Bring the knees back to the middle. Rest.
Press lightly through the right foot, so the right knee goes forward a little. Notice how the right side of the pelvis lifts.
Rest, and notice how your back lies on the floor now.
